items.task: Create a real-life situation that uses multiplication through grouping and arrays. Record the quantities and explain your reasoning.
Find one example at home/school of multiplication by 10, 100 and 1000. Draw or photograph the representation and label it.
Design a pair activity for doubling and halving. Each partner must explain the answer in a different way.
Collect two measurements or observations connected to distributive property and compare them.
Make a small poster teaching multi-digit multiplication to a younger learner. Include one worked example.
Invent a challenge based on multiplication in dairy and money contexts; exchange it with a classmate and check the solution.
